kill_fact: The value ENTRY case fails on independently verified numbers, on three legs. Only management's own $147 DCF makes it favorable, and a company's intrinsic model is not verified edge. (2) THE BEAR'S BREAK-CONDITION IS NOW THE COMPANY'S OWN GUIDANCE: the bear says the case breaks 'if growth normalizes toward high-single-digits and margins settle a notch lower' — the FY27 guide issued 2026-05-21 (three months AFTER the SCOTUS IEEPA ruling, so the tariff headwind survives the legal win) is exactly that: revenue $5.86-5.91B (+7-8%), EPS $7.30-7.45 (+4-6%), GM ~56.5% (a TRUE -120bps from the actual 57.7%, not roughly-flat as the debate's stale 56.1% anchor implied), OM ~21.5% from 23.1%. Domestic net sales were FLAT all of FY26 (+0.2% to $3.19B; international +26.8% carried everything) — the US, ~58% of revenue, has stopped growing. (3) THE BEAR TRIP-WIRE IS GUIDED TO FIRE AT THE NEXT PRINT: bear confirmation = 'HOKA decelerates below low-teens'; management itself guided the June quarter to HIGH-SINGLE-DIGIT HOKA growth (framed as one-time wholesale timing: EU warehouse comp, delayed APAC distributor orders, Clifton launch) with Q1 FY27 EPS $0.82-0.87 vs ~$0.93 LY — a guided EPS-down print ~3-4 weeks out, with catalyst_status SOFT_EXTENDED verified (no forcing function; the $5B buyback supports the floor but forces nothing). (4) HIDDEN DISQUALIFIER THE DEBATE NEVER SAW: on 2026-06-15 a N.D. Cal. jury found UGG Ultra Mini design patent D927,161 INVALID in Deckers v. Quince (infringement found but mooted, zero damages), after the court had earlier dismissed the trade-dress claims — the anti-dupe IP shield on the LARGER SoP leg (UGG $2.74B, valued $4.1-6.9B in every SoP scenario) is impaired going into holiday. Quality and balance sheet verify (better than modeled), so DECK survives as a watchlist name toward the ~$80 floor — but the value entry thesis as argued is broken.
corrections: (1) risk_reward '1.3-to-1' fails arithmetic — ~0.5-to-1 at the $105 anchor, ~0.9-to-1 at $100.33 vs the corrected ~$81 floor. (2) Net cash understated: FY26 release shows $1.907B cash and NO outstanding borrowings (the $375M 'debt' is operating leases); true net cash ~$1.9B (~$13/sh), not $1.53B — lifts every SoP leg ~$2.5/sh, floor ~$78→~$81. (3) FY26 gross margin was 57.7% (press release), not 56.1% (stale screener TTM) — so the guided FY27 GM step-down is a real -120bps, LARGER than the debate implied; this correction strengthens the bear's margin leg. (4) sop_bear's cross-check ('12-13x a ~$7.40 FY27 EPS stream plus excess cash lands ~$78') is wrong: 12.5x $7.40 + $13 cash ≈ $105; $78 implies ~8.8x ex-cash. The segment math (HOKA 2.2x / UGG 1.5x sales) does independently reproduce ~$78-81, and the stock's actual 52-week low of $78.91 shows that floor is market-tested — the floor stands, the cross-check as written does not. (5) Buyback understated: authorization was raised BY $3.5B to ~$5.0B TOTAL (~36% of the current $13.9B cap); FY26 repurchases $1.075B / 10.5M shares. (6) Most recent quarter EPS -4% YoY ($0.96 vs $1.00), not ~-3% (minor). (7) Tariff-refund optionality upgraded from undated hope to a live legal claim: SCOTUS struck the IEEPA tariffs 6-3 on 2026-02-20 (Learning Resources v. Trump, 24-1287); DECK confirmed ~$120M gross duties paid, refunds pursued, excluded from FY27 guidance — but management said refunds would be shared with cost-sharing partners, and FY27 guidance still embeds a 10% current-rate tariff under successor authorities, so the refund (~$0.8/sh gross) does not repair the entry math. (8) Segment figures verify exactly: HOKA $2.587B (+15.9%), UGG $2.739B (+8.2%), Other $146.2M (-33.9%, Koolaburra wind-down); diluted shares 145.8M. (9) No other disqualifiers: the old Percoco (UGG) securities class action was dismissed; zero debt, no covenants.
